text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

THE NATION - The Malawi High Court on Monday granted an injunction to the main opposition Malawi Congres Party (MCP) restraining the Electoral Commission from conducting by-elections in Blantyre city scheduled for December 23.
- Opposition parties boycotting parliament on Monday said National Assembly Rodwell Munyenyembe's decision to let parliament sit without a quorum was illegal and they would challenge this in court.
- Speaker of the National Assembly Rodwell Munyenyembe on Monday ruled that parliament proceed with its business despite the absence of opposition parties.

- The High court in Blantyre on Monday granted the main opposition Malawi Congress Party an interim injunction against the Electoral Commission preventing it from conducting nominations for party candicates to stand in the Blantyre City Central by-elections.
